## Method change

What transformation, estimator, model, or infrastructure changed?

## Falsification boundary

What result would count against the scientific interpretation? A scientifically negative result should remain a valid green-CI outcome when the computation itself succeeds.

## Reproduction

- [ ] Starts from public or explicitly permitted inputs
- [ ] Target/data identity is mechanically checked before analysis
- [ ] Raw telescope products are not unnecessarily vendored
- [ ] Software environment / versions are recorded
- [ ] Generated results state their scientific boundary
- [ ] Licensing and attribution are preserved
